scientific_use: DO NOT USE the parent near_duplicate_candidates.csv, near_duplicate_summary.json, source_family_edges.csv, source_family_membership.csv, source_family_summary.json, additional_cross_split_candidates.csv, or the near/family fields in execution_record.json as final evidence. exhaustive_hamming/ is the first-pass partial review (20810 reviewed, 12335 CAP backlog); use cap_resolution/ as the authoritative merged result only after its independent verification passes.

defect.cause: Exact-D4 seed pairs were appended with unsorted record indices while LSH pairs used sorted indices. The same logical pair could appear twice in reversed orientation.
defect.effect: Candidate/category counts and high-confidence counts were inflated; graph union-find deduplicated logical pairs and therefore disagreed with the candidate summary.
defect.independent_check: Python CSV key-set comparison found 503436 rows versus 500000 unique (split,sample_id) pairs; every high-confidence candidate pair was present in the graph, but the graph also contained exact-D4 edges.
defect.remediation: Sort exact-D4 seed indices, preserve the defective implementation as scripts/legacy_lsh_defect_version.py, and regenerate all near/family outputs with exhaustive all-pairs prefiltering.

preservation.original_outputs_git_delivery: EXCLUDED as non-authoritative; server-side diagnostic evidence retained

exact_result_boundary: The defect was confined to near-candidate construction and downstream counts. It did not alter file hashes, decoded-pixel hashes, D4 canonical hashes, exact relation pairs, upstream byte identity, or positive-control results.
